text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. Narita Brian 
resolves to win this race and go talk to 
Biwa Hayahide.

Hishi Amazon was also among today's 
opponents. It would be their first GⅠ 
rematch since last year's Arima Kinen.

She asks Narita Brian: How does she intend 
to run the rest of her racing life...?

Narita Brian answered that she would keep 
running and remain a challenger. A 
one-on-one showdown between two girls 
driven by conviction begins.
